caller_input.prompt:
You are working read-only on the project open in IntelliJ IDEA, a small Spring Boot fixture. Use only the IntelliJ MCP tools mcp__intellij__analyze_calls and mcp__intellij__get_symbol_info. Do not edit, write or run anything; built-in Write/Edit/Bash are denied by the harness.

In src/main/java/demo/TransferService.java:
- line 13 `doTransfer(from, to, amount);` is a call on `this` from transfer() to the @Transactional doTransfer();
- line 37 `public void outer(Long id) { inner(id); }` calls the @Transactional(REQUIRES_NEW) inner() on `this`;
- line 17 `repo.addToBalance(from, -amount);` calls the injected Spring Data repository bean (a Spring proxy).

1. analyze_calls OUTGOING_CALLS, depth 2, for demo.TransferService.outer, demo.TransferService.transfer and demo.TransferService.doTransfer.
2. analyze_calls INCOMING_CALLS, depth 2, for demo.TransferService.inner, demo.TransferService.doTransfer and demo.AccountRepository.addToBalance.
3. get_symbol_info at the call sites: line 13 column 5 (doTransfer), line 37 column 32 (inner), line 17 column 10 (addToBalance); and at the declarations: line 39 column 15, line 16 column 15.
4. If a symbolFqn is ambiguous, pass back the exact signature the tool offers.

FINAL ANSWER: every tool output verbatim (no paraphrase). Then one line per call site stating, only from fields present in the outputs, whether any output marks that edge as a call through `this`, through an injected bean, or through a Spring proxy, quoting the field if there is one; write "no such field" otherwise.
